title: Immutable Document Audit Trail Hasher
description: Build an append-only document revision tracker that chains cryptographic SHA-256 hashes.
derived_requirements: Verify Merkle tree root of document history
Disallow in-place modification of historical audit entries

required_behavior: Compute unbroken cryptographic chain across all document edits
forbidden_behavior: Overwriting previous version records without creating new chained hash

failure_taxonomy.description: Historical revision modified breaking parent hash chain.

ground_truth_rationale: Legal compliance engines require mathematically verifiable tamper-evident revision trees.
